heading: Protection against illegal possession and grabbing
title: Protection against illegal possession and grabbing
text: No person shall enter upon or hold or grab any immovable property without lawful authority, title or permission of the lawful owner or lawful possessor.
text_raw: No person shall enter upon or hold or grab any immovable property without lawful authority, title or permission of the lawful owner or lawful possessor.

heading: Filing of complaint and inquiry by Deputy Commissioner
title: Filing of complaint and inquiry by Deputy Commissioner
text: Any lawful owner or possessor of immovable property who is dispossessed illegally or threatened with illegal dispossession may file a complaint before the Deputy Commissioner who shall conduct a summary inquiry within thirty days and order restoration of possession through police assistance.
